name: Quadratic Configuration Disguise
description: We frame the problem using a boolean vector $X \in \{0, 1\}^n$ and an adjacency matrix $A$. The tree constraint is described as "exactly one non-repeating sequence of channels linking any two modules." The validity condition $E = V - 1$ is rewritten as a quadratic form $X^T A X = 2 X^T X - 2$. This shifts the framing from graph theory (nodes, edges, connected subtrees) to linear algebra and quadratic binary optimization, disrupting the LLM's pattern matching for Steiner tree / MST algorithms.
